notes.title: We're coming to Baltic Dev Days!
notes.content:
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/cf5748_10c59ab00ee24b988375c3990ad17705~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_792,h_261,al_c,q_80,usm_1.20_1.00_0.01/Logo-Color-white.webp[/img]

[h1]Laufen und Raufen playable at Baltic Dev Days! [/h1]

We're happy to announce that Laufen und Raufen will be playable at the Nurogames booth at the Baltic Dev Days 2019 in Kiel.
For more information and tickets head to [url=https://www.balticdevdays.com/]www.balticdevdays.com[/url]
